post.description: A zip archive of at most `PACK_UPLOAD_MAX_MB` (default 20) with at most 2,000 entries and declared sizes of at most five times that limit, with the pack at its root or in its one top-level directory. The draft keeps the files of the pack layout (`pack.yaml`, `sources.yaml`, `glossary.yaml`, `segments.yaml`, `stations.yaml`, `feedback.yaml`, `qualifications.yaml`, `formats.yaml`, `modules/<dir>/{module,objectives,rules,items,assessment}.yaml` and `modules/<dir>/lessons/<key>.md`) and the captions files `.vtt` below `media/` as text files; each kept file is UTF-8 text without U+0000 of at most 1,048,576 bytes. Every other file below `media/` whose path passes the media path rules, at most 500 (`max_draft_media`), becomes an asset of the media library and a media entry of the draft at its delivery path (`.webp`, `.svg` or `.webm`), and the directives of the lessons follow the new paths. A media file that the library refuses and two media files with one delivery path reject the archive with 422 entries at their paths. These media files never appear in `skipped`, which lists every other file of the archive. A draft holds at most 2,000 files of at most 1,048,576 bytes each and at most five times `PACK_UPLOAD_MAX_MB` (default 20) in total; at most 50 drafts exist.

post.description: Accepted files, detected from their leading bytes, with the extension of the detected kind: images `.png` (`89 50 4E 47 0D 0A 1A 0A`), `.jpg` and `.jpeg` (`FF D8 FF`), `.gif` (`GIF87a`, `GIF89a`) and `.webp` (`RIFF`, four bytes, `WEBP`) of at most `MEDIA_IMAGE_MAX_MB` (default 20) and 40,000,000 pixels; SVG `.svg` (`<?xml`, `<svg` or `<!--` after an optional BOM) of at most 1,048,576 bytes; videos `.mp4`, `.m4v` and `.mov` (`ftyp` at offset 4, no HEIF brand) and `.webm` and `.mkv` (`1A 45 DF A3`) of at most `MEDIA_VIDEO_MAX_MB` (default 1024), `MEDIA_VIDEO_MAX_MINUTES` (default 60) and 3840 by 2160 pixels; captions `.vtt` (`WEBVTT`) of at most 524,288 bytes. Images become WebP with at most `MEDIA_IMAGE_MAX_EDGE` pixels per edge (animated images at most 1,000 frames), videos WebM with VP9 and Opus at most `MEDIA_VIDEO_MAX_HEIGHT` high, SVG files are rebuilt from an allowlist, and captions are checked. The media store holds at most `MEDIA_STORAGE_MAX_GB` (default 50).

get.description: Sends the files and the media files in the pack layout at the root of a zip archive named `<pack key>-draft.zip`, or `pack-draft.zip` without a usable pack key. The media of a draft stay within `export_max_mb` (1,024 MB; 409 `download_too_large`), and a media file that is not ready answers 409 `media_not_ready`. At most two downloads run at once, one per user; a download builds the archive in one of the two slots of the checks and imports and frees it before the transfer. When the user runs a download already or no slot is free, the download answers 429 `checks_busy` and builds nothing. The transfer ends at its deadline, the size of the archive at 256 KiB per second and at least 60 seconds, or when the client reads nothing for 30 seconds; the client then holds fewer bytes than `content-length`.
